faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to our most common inquiries.
faq.q1: Are GLOWMI recommendations a substitute for medical advice?
faq.a1: No. Glowmi AI and our advisors provide educational skincare guidance only. We do not diagnose, treat, or prescribe. For medical skin concerns, please consult a dermatologist.
faq.q2: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
faq.a2: Orders are processed quickly to ensure fast delivery. Please contact our Order Support team immediately via WhatsApp or the contact form, and we will do our best to assist you.
faq.q3: Are the products suitable for sensitive skin?
faq.a3: Yes, our curated products are specifically selected for their clean, high-performance profiles, with many options formulated specifically to strengthen sensitive skin in the Gulf climate.
